title: Set or clear one role's access rule for a scope (execute)
description: Step 2 of 2 for change a role's access rule. Verifies the confirmation_hash from -prepare and the literal "confirm" string typed by the user, then performs the action. ONLY call this after the user has explicitly typed "confirm" in chat. Original action: Sets the level every member of one role gets for one scope. A role rule wins over the default, and a member's own rule wins over it. The scope is the project (`resource: project` with the project id as `resource_id`, level `none`, `member` or `admin`), a whole tool (`resource: dashboard`, level `none`, `viewer`, `editor` or `manager`), one object (add `resource_id`), or one property (`resource: property_definition`, level `none`, `read` or `read_write`). A project level of `none` blocks access to the project and its resources. A null `access_level` removes the role's rule. An empty result means the rule is cleared. Role rules are enforced only on plans with role-based access. Read access-control-roles-list with `role_id` first and tell the user the current and new level before asking for confirmation. Requires human typed confirmation.

methodDocumentation.text: Set or clear one role's rule for a scope. A role rule applies to every member of the role and takes precedence over the default. Requires the role-based access feature. The scope is the project (`resource: project` with the project id as `resource_id`), a whole resource type, one object, or one property definition. A null `access_level` removes the rule. Returns the stored rule, or 204 with no body when the rule is cleared.
